# Ladeco Diag Workspace Instructions

- Architecture: Clean Architecture + MVVM.
- Tech stack: C#, .NET 9, WPF, Serilog, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm, LiveCharts2, QuestPDF, EF Core Sqlite.
- User-facing text must be localizable (no hardcoded UI strings).
- Every step should keep the solution compileable.
